text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting authority to replace the yield sign on Airdrie Road at the intersection with Crofton Road with a stop sign. A stop sign will clearly define the right-of-way between vehicles and pedestrians at this intersection and allow for the installation of a stop bar and crosswalk markings on the south leg of the intersection.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing yield control on Airdrie Road at the intersection with Crofton Road. 2. Approved stop control on Airdrie Road at the intersection with Crofton Road.
